findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: -Inspector observed the top of the dish machine to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC. PIC has cleaned the machine since the last inspection, but the soils have built up again. Inspector recommends increasing frequency of dish machine cleanings. Ensure the top of the dish machine is cleaned regularly enough to keep it free of soils.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the top of the dish machine to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC, area will be cleaned. Ensure all non food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency that prevent accumulation. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: The facility was observed to have the order sheet from Kellner showing that they did order the test strips, however, after inspecting the shipment and putting it away, no test strips were observed with the delivery. During the inspection, the PIC texted the delivery driver with Kellner. With no response from the delivery driver during today’s inspection, an additional follow-up will take place after Christmas break. After discussion with the PIC, the follow-up will take place on Tuesday, January 9th, 2024.
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
A certified food protection manager (CFPM) must be present during hours of operation.  Along with the CFPM certification, an allergen awareness training certification must also be obtained for all high risk facilities.  Ensure the kitchen manager obtains these certifications.

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
At time of inspection, the sanitizer bucket had a concentration of 0 ppm (q).  Discussed with PIC, who stated that she also adds Dawn dish soap to the sanitizer.  Inspector advised PIC to not add soap to sanitizer as it affects the sanitizer concentration.  COS

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Test strips were not available at time of inspection.  Discussed with PIC, who will be ordering on 12/19/23.  Ensure test strips are available at all times to check sanitizer concentration.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Paint is peeling/chipping off the wall by the dish machine.  Ensure the peeling paint is removed and repainted to create a smooth, easily cleanable surface.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Dish counter to the left of the dish machine needs to be re-caulked.  The caulk present is cracked and coming away from the wall.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure this area is re-caulked to create a smooth, non-absorbent, easily cleanable surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Heat sanitation is used in the dish machine, no chemical sanitizer is used.   No temperature measuring device is available to measure the temperature in the dish machine.  PIC was informed a temperature measuring device is required. Ensure a measuring device is present and readily available.

4-204.115: A WAREWASHING machine shall be equipped with a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE that indicates the temperature of the water

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Non contact food surfaces were observed to contain dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris:  box fan used in the kitchen for staff, fan in the walk in cooler and spray nozzle over dish area. The dust could cause cross contamination on food and non food contact surfaces.  Ensure fan blades are cleaned regularly to prevent the build up debris.  Spray nozzle over dish sink was observed to contain food debris.  Ensure spray nozzle, handle, and spray head are cleaned regularly to prevent cross contamination.

601.11: (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.
